text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Reporting. I placed, but failed to obtain
first.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I determined the cause to be a lack of
training
and poor judgment. If these
issues are not
addressed, we risk even
worse results.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I ask that we review the race to quickly
resolve
these problems.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
I ask that we review the race to quickly
resolve
these problems.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Acknowledged. "Full Speed to Victory"
mode
activated. In addition, I am setting
you as my
running partner.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
With you by my side, we will grasp
victory.

We return to the academy and look
back on the
race, exchanging opinions
on how she can
improve.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Entering a state of franticness. Awaiting
orders.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Please whip me into shape so that I can
achieve
victory.

We return to the academy and look
back on the
race with a critical eye. We
make a plan to
improve Bourbon's sense
of judgment!
